response.reason: The clause requires that if the country of origin of a food is given and it is not the same as that of its primary ingredient, the origin of the primary ingredient must also be given or it must be indicated that it is different. In the scenario described in the verdict, both the food and its primary ingredient have the same country of origin (Belgium), so the requirement to declare a different origin does not apply. The clause thus supports the verdict that the requirement is satisfied in this case.
